title: Career cities Part 6: Asia, part one, with Ledger in under 2 minutes
summary: Part 6 of the career cities series covers 9 niche hubs across east asia, one sourced fact and the jobs available at each stop, as Hoang asked on 15 Nov.

beats.label: title card
beats.voice: Career cities with Ledger, part six: Asia, part one, in under two minutes.
beats.visual: Title card over a world map with the earlier parts as small lit dots; the pins for this part drop in one by one; Ledger waves with his suitcase

beats.label: stop 1 Jingdezhen, China, porcelain (arrival)
beats.voice: First, Ledger lands in Jingdezhen, China, a hub for porcelain.
beats.visual: Map view: a flight path of dots grows from the last pin to Jingdezhen, the pin pops and the China flag shows in its label (borders drawn); camera drops into the city scene: a kiln chimney beside a big blue-and-white vase on a plate reading JINGDEZHEN grows out of the pin, Ledger walks in with his suitcase, the flag pole pops in and the flag rises and waves, clouds drift

beats.label: stop 1 Jingdezhen, China, porcelain (fact and jobs)
beats.voice: Handmade porcelain here supported over 50,000 jobs in 2025, from potters to exporters.
beats.visual: Products appear one by one as the voice reaches the number: bowl, vase, teapot; the number counts up on a fact card that stamps in; job chips (potter, glaze designer, export manager) pop beside Ledger; no logos here (no single big company sourced), product icons only; Ledger changes pose twice

caption:
Career cities with Ledger, Part 6, is the first of three trips across Asia, starting in East Asia, with 9 stops, and each stop shows one niche industry that town is a hub for, with a sourced fact and the jobs you could have there

So you will meet Jingdezhen, Yiwu, Shenzhen, Qingdao, Hsinchu, Toyota City, Sabae, Ulsan, and Ulaanbaatar

Save the map for later, because Part 7 maps career cities across Southeast Asia
